TRIGGER WHEN: migrating JS to TS, bootstrapping a TS project, writing generics, conditional/mapped/branded types, discriminated unions, Zod schemas, or typing React/NestJS. DO NOT TRIGGER WHEN: routine TS style (use typescript-write), React performance (use react-development:react-best-practices), or dead code (use knip).
entries.name: mastering-typescript

entries.description: 20 rules across 7 categories, each with detection and fix guidance. TRIGGER WHEN: reviewing or hardening TypeScript against type-system erosion: `any` leakage, unsound casts, missing boundary validation, assertion abuse, tsconfig strictness, exhaustiveness and generics soundness. DO NOT TRIGGER WHEN: style and naming review (use typescript-write), or dead-code detection (use knip).
entries.name: type-safety-rules

entries.description: Apply house coding standards to everyday application work. TRIGGER WHEN: writing or reviewing TypeScript/JavaScript code, including types, generics, async patterns, module boundaries, and style conventions. DO NOT TRIGGER WHEN: React performance (use react-development), or advanced type-system depth (use mastering-typescript).
entries.name: typescript-write

entries.description: Shared working discipline, run identity, snapshots, delivery/verification accounting, authorization continuity, user questions and phase recovery. Load before authoring components/tools, briefing workers, asking users, recording, resuming or closing project interventions.
entries.name: work-record

entries.description: Manage Git task workspaces through the external Worktrunk CLI: create or resume under .daodan, list every worktree, annotate descriptions and tags, prepare safe lifecycle handoffs and check supported upstream releases. TRIGGER WHEN: starting or resuming an isolated task, listing or annotating worktrees, preparing their integration or cleanup, or updating Worktrunk compatibility. DO NOT TRIGGER WHEN: reviewing code correctness or deciding whether a task is complete; those decisions remain with the existing review and delivery owners.
entries.name: worktree-method

entries.description: Build, configure, debug and extend browser and Electron terminal UIs with xterm.js (@xterm/xterm). TRIGGER WHEN: working with xterm.js, @xterm/xterm, FitAddon, WebglAddon, SearchAddon, AttachAddon, node-pty over WebSocket, ANSI/VT sequences, or embedding a web terminal in React/Vue/Electron.
entries.name: xtermjs-skill
